description_en: Queries the daily historical active user count for a tenant within a specified time range. Based on offline statistical data, this operation aggregates and deduplicates active users by date to calculate daily active users (DAU). Filtering by user group and workspace is supported
description_zh: 查询租户在指定时间范围内的每日历史活跃用户数量。基于离线统计数据，按日期维度聚合去重统计每天的活跃用户数（DAU），支持按用户组和工作区筛选
name: QueryHistoryActiveUserStatistic

parameters.help_en: The start date of the query. The date is in the yyyy-MM-dd format. The value cannot be earlier than 6 months ago or later than EndDate
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，日期格式为yyyy-MM-dd。不能早于6个月前，不能晚于EndDate
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end date of the query. The date is in the yyyy-MM-dd format. The maximum value is yesterday (N-1 data)
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，日期格式为yyyy-MM-dd。最大值为昨天（N-1数据）
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en: The user group ID. If specified, only active users within the specified user group are counted
parameters.help_zh: 用户组ID。传入时仅统计指定用户组内的活跃用户
parameters.name: user_group_id

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. If specified, only active users within the specified workspace are counted
parameters.help_zh: 工作区ID。传入时仅统计指定工作区下的活跃用户
parameters.name: office_site_id

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of returned entries

UserStatisticList.description_en: The list of daily active user statistics
UserStatisticList.description_zh: 每日活跃用户统计列表

ActiveUserCount.description_en: The number of deduplicated active users on the day

FormatDate.description_en: The date in the standard yyyy-MM-dd format, in the UTC+8 time zone
FormatDate.description_zh: 标准格式日期，格式为yyyy-MM-dd，东八区

TimeStamp.description_en: The timestamp of the date, in milliseconds
TimeStamp.description_zh: 日期的时间戳，单位为毫秒
